review_basis: Human visual review of rendered vector PDF sheets M8.3, M8.4, M8.7 and M8.8 (PDF pages 19, 20, 23 and 24). M8.3 and M8.4 each contain one hydronic control diagram, point-function schedule and authored SOO. M8.8 contains eight authored control-diagram details; six have adjacent authored SOOs, while Lighting Control and Emergency Shutdown do not and are intentionally unbound. Expectations describe source truth, not prior engine output.
